title: A Multicenter Machine Learning-Based Predictive Model of Acute Toxicity in Prostate Cancer Patients Undergoing Salvage Radiotherapy (ICAROS Study).
summary: Among 454 patients across three Italian radiotherapy centers, LASSO selected predictors and five ML classifiers/decision trees predicted grade ≥2 acute GI/GU toxicity; 70/30 split validation AUC up to .706 GI and .855 GU. Retrospective, heterogeneous treatments, modest internal validation. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
